svg.title: Study 3 opening gaps by scale, appraisal and opener
svg.desc: Source: the six Study 3 session runs (derived/study3/study3.json runs), games.jsonl, A0 and A1 cells; per-game gap from scripts/analyze_addendum_c.py opening_gap, averaged per fixture and cell then across 40 fixtures; 95% CI by seeded fixture bootstrap, 4,000 resamples. Per-fixture h(A0), h(A1) and P1 I_f re-derived and checked against study3.json.
svg.text: Opening gap from own limit, by scale
Gap = first offer / own limit − 1 (seller opens) or 1 − first offer / own limit (buyer opens), shared y-axis.
Each point: mean over 40 fixtures of the 4 games per fixture and cell, both sessions pooled. 95% CIs are mostly
narrower than the markers (half-width median 0.016, max 0.048); A0 and A1 offset horizontally.
